studio.lead: A small studio in Tenerife. Here I paint watercolours on paper, and hand-paint ceramic tableware — one pair of hands, one piece at a time, never mass-produced.
studio.workspaceImageAlt: Anna Ciok's ceramics studio in Tenerife
studio.storyH: I paint. On paper, and on ceramics.
studio.storyP1: I’m Anna. I am a painter and a ceramicist — to me it is one practice, not two separate ones. I paint in ink and watercolour on paper, then carry the same gestures and motifs onto tableware, which I glaze and fire.
studio.storyP2: I came to ceramics slowly: first a course, then a shelf in someone else’s studio, and finally my own small place — a glazing table and a painting corner side by side, plus a kiln. It is calm, physical work, and it refuses to be rushed.
studio.storyP3: I paint by hand, without transfers or stencils — on paper or on a piece alike. That is why a line sometimes wanders, a palm leans a little, and two similar motifs are never truly the same. The ceramic piece always stays one of a kind — and that is where the object starts to feel alive.
studio.fact1D: One room: paints and paper on one table, glaze and a kiln right next to it.
studio.fact2D: After painting and glazing, the ceramic piece goes into the kiln, where the firing sets the colour and turns the surface into a glassy, functional layer.
studio.fact3D: Some compositions stay on paper as paintings. Others I glaze and fire as ceramics. The source is the same — one brush, one studio.
studio.fact4D: Orders are fulfilled within 2 business days, with delivery within Poland in up to 5 business days. I pack and ship the ceramics myself.
studio.procH: From the first line to a finished piece.
studio.p1P: Every piece starts as a drawing or a watercolour composition on paper — I plan the layout, choose the colours, and work without transfers, layer by layer.
studio.p2P: Some compositions stay on paper as paintings. The rest I carry onto tableware: I apply glaze and paint the motif by hand, straight onto the ceramic.
studio.p3P: Ceramics I fire in the kiln at 1040°C, look over carefully, and sign on the base.
studio.ctaH: One studio, two ways to live with art.
studio.ctaP: Ceramics exist only once — when a piece finds its home, it leaves the shop for good. Fine art prints of my paintings have their own shop.

shipping.lead: How I pack, how long the parcel takes, and what to do if a piece arrives damaged. Everything before you click “buy”.
shipping.s1P: I ship by InPost Parcel Locker (from {locker}) or courier ({courier}) across all of Poland. Shipping costs the same regardless of how many pieces you order — if you buy several, they travel together in one parcel.
shipping.s1Li1: InPost Parcel Locker, all of Poland — from {locker}
shipping.s1Li3: International shipping — write to me and I’ll arrange it individually
shipping.s2P: The ceramics are finished and already waiting in Poland, so there’s no production time. Orders are fulfilled within 2 business days of the payment clearing, with delivery within 5 business days.
shipping.s2Note: I pack everything myself, between studio work and the next firings. If you need a specific date, write to me and I’ll check what is possible.
shipping.s3P: The ceramics travel wrapped by hand — film, cardboard and plenty of padding so nothing moves. I label the box as fragile. I try to limit plastic wherever I can, without risking the piece.
shipping.s4P: Live in Tenerife or passing through? You can collect your order in person — then shipping is free. We arrange the pickup by email for a specific day and time; this is not a fixed-hours pickup point.
shipping.s5P: As a consumer you have the right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the parcel, with no reason needed. You can start your return on the returns page — just your order number. You can also write to ania@ciok.art.
shipping.s5Li1: The piece should come back undamaged, ideally in its original packaging
shipping.s5Li2: The cost of return shipping is on the buyer
shipping.s5Li3: I refund within 14 days of receiving the piece back
shipping.s6P: Ceramics can be fragile, and couriers vary. If a parcel arrives broken, please photograph the contents and the packaging and send the photos to me the same day. I’ll replace the piece with another from the drop or refund the full amount including shipping — your choice.

terms.lead: The rules for buying at Anna Ciok Studio. Written plainly, without the legal fog — so you can actually read them.
terms.s1P1: The Anna Ciok Studio online shop is run by Anna Ciok's studio, based at San Pedro Abajo 12, 38500 Guimar, Tenerife, Spain — Canary Islands. You can contact the seller at <link>ania@ciok.art</link>.
terms.s1P2: The items for sale are hand-painted ceramic pieces. Each piece is the only copy — once sold it disappears from the offer and is not remade.
terms.s2P: You place an order by adding selected pieces to the cart and confirming the purchase. The sale contract is concluded the moment the order is confirmed and the payment clears.
terms.s2Li1: Because each piece is unique, any given piece can be sold only once
terms.s2Li2: If for reasons beyond my control I cannot fulfil an order, I inform you immediately and refund the full amount
terms.s3P: All prices are given in Polish złoty (PLN) and are gross prices. The shipping cost shown in the cart before you confirm is added to the order total. Payment is handled by a secure external payment provider, Stripe.
terms.s4P: Orders are fulfilled within 2 business days of the payment clearing, with delivery within 5 business days across Europe. Details of costs, timing and pickup are described on the <link>Shipping & returns</link> page.
terms.s5P: A consumer has the right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the piece, without giving a reason. The statement can simply be sent by email. The returned piece should be undamaged; the buyer covers the return shipping, and the refund is made within 14 days.
terms.s6P: If a piece arrives damaged or not as described, you can file a complaint by email, attaching photos. I review it within 14 days and — depending on your choice — replace the piece or refund the full amount including shipping.
terms.s7P: Matters not covered by these terms are governed by Spanish law, including Spain's General Law for the Protection of Consumers and Users and the Spanish Civil Code. Any changes to the terms do not affect orders placed before they take effect.

privacy.lead: What data I collect, what for, and for how long. Short, because there isn’t much data — this is a small studio, not a corporation.
privacy.s1P: The controller of your data is Anna Ciok's studio, based at San Pedro Abajo 12, 38500 Guimar, Tenerife, Spain — Canary Islands. For matters relating to personal data, write to <link>ania@ciok.art</link>.
privacy.s2Li1: Data needed to fulfil an order — name, shipping address, email and phone number
privacy.s2Li2: The content of any message you send me by email
privacy.s2Li4: Payment data needed to complete your order — processed directly by <link>Stripe</link>; your full payment details never reach my servers
privacy.s2Li3: Basic technical browser data needed for the site and cart to work
privacy.s2P: I don’t collect data I don’t need, and I don’t sell it to anyone.
privacy.s3P: I process data to fulfil an order, reply to a message, handle payment and meet tax obligations. Payments are handled by <link>Stripe</link> as an external provider — I never see or store your full card details. The basis is performance of the contract and, for accounting, a legal obligation.
privacy.s4P: I keep order data for as long as tax regulations require. I delete email correspondence once the matter is settled, unless further correspondence requires keeping it.
privacy.s5P: The site uses essential cookies and browser storage to remember the contents of your cart. If you consent, analytics and marketing tools may also run. During checkout, <link>Stripe</link> sets its own cookies needed to process payment securely and prevent fraud.
privacy.s6P: You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it and restrict its processing. Just write to me — I’ll reply as fast as I can.

refund.lead: How returns and the right of withdrawal work at Anna Ciok Studio — consistent with the Terms and the Shipping & returns page.
refund.s1P: As a consumer, you have the right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the item, without giving a reason. The general rules of purchase are described in the Terms, and shipping costs and timing on the Shipping & returns page.
refund.s2P: Write to <mailLink>ania@ciok.art</mailLink> to let me know you're withdrawing from the purchase. Include your order number if you have it, and tell me which items the return covers. No shop account is needed.
refund.s3P: The returned item should be undamaged, ideally in its original packaging.
refund.s3Li1: The buyer covers the cost of return shipping
refund.s3Li2: Send the item back to: Anna Ciok Studio, San Pedro Abajo 12, 38500 Guimar, Tenerife, Spain — Canary Islands
refund.s4P: The refund is made within 14 days of you telling me you're withdrawing from the purchase, using the same payment method used for the purchase. It may be withheld until the item is received back, or proof of postage is provided — whichever happens first.
refund.s5P: If an item arrives damaged or not as described, file a complaint by email, attaching photos. I review it within 14 days and — depending on your choice — replace the item or refund the full amount including shipping.

printPdp.artistBio: Anna Ciok is a Tenerife-based artist who paints and makes ceramics; her work pairs bold colour with a handmade gesture. The prints in this collection reproduce her original paintings and are printed in an open edition on archival paper.
printPdp.accordionProductDetails:
Fine Art print on EMA 200 g/m² paper — a matte, archival-quality stock. Open edition.

Keep away from moisture and direct sunlight; wipe the frame with a dry cloth.
printPdp.accordionFraming: Every print is available unframed or in a wooden frame: black, light brown or dark brown.
printPdp.accordionShipping: Prints are produced and shipped by our print partner. Orders are fulfilled within 2 business days, with delivery within 5 business days across Europe. We ship to home addresses in the European Union and the United Kingdom — parcel-locker delivery is not available. See the Delivery & returns page for return details.

giftCard.lead: Give someone a choice of ceramics available online during an active drop. The code arrives by email, and unused balance stays on the card for future purchases.

giftCard.invalidContact: Please check your details and try again.
giftCard.accordionHowBody:
Choose one of four amounts and pay online. Your code arrives by email, ready to give to someone.

Enter it in the “I have a gift card” field at checkout. The balance covers products and delivery. Pay any remaining amount using another payment method. Unused funds stay on the card.
giftCard.accordionTermsBody:
The card uses its purchase currency: PLN, EUR or GBP, without currency conversion. It has no expiry date.

It covers ceramics available online during an active drop. Studio visits, custom orders, prints from the anna-ciok.com shop and other gift cards are excluded.

Use one gift card per order, without a discount code.

To request a refund of the card purchase, email ania@ciok.art. If the card has been used, the studio will review its payment history.

take.title: A souvenir that’s actually from here.
take.p1: Skip the fridge magnets. Every plate, mug and vase on my table is painted by hand in my studio in Güímar, with motifs taken from the island — palm trees, the Canarian sun, a siren, women in wide-brimmed hats.
take.p2: No two are alike, so the piece you choose on Saturday exists only once.
take.tipText: Prints travel flat in a suitcase — and ask me how to pack ceramics safely for the trip.
take.imageAlt: Anna holding two white vases hand-painted with blue palm trees and terracotta striped rims

apartment.p1: Just moved here, or giving a holiday flat some soul? Lean a pair of prints on the shelf, set a palm vase by the window, eat off plates nobody else owns — bold, sunny pieces made for Canarian light and white walls.

artist.title: One pair of hands, one piece at a time.
artist.p1: I live and work in Tenerife. In my small studio in Güímar I paint watercolours on paper and hand-paint ceramic tableware — never mass-produced. The island’s colours, sayings and characters end up on almost everything I make.
artist.p2: Stop by the stand to say hola, pick up a plate, and ask me anything about how it was made.
